title: Explore Washington DC: Self-Guided Audio Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Tour downloading instructions are in the "Before You Go" section of your ticket.
No admission fees or physical guide included.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Washington DC, the majestic capital of the United States of America. Taking architectural influences from ancient Rome, Greece, and Egypt, the grandiose intentions of the city’s designers are clear.

Perfectly suited for discovery on foot, our self-guided audio tour allows you to set your own pace and explore at your leisure as you uncover the stories of this dynamic city.

Immerse yourself in the heart of the USA's political and cultural centre at the Smithsonian Institute and the United States Capitol. This Citywalks World tour is a unique opportunity to learn the history of Washington D.C and see the architectural marvels that comprise it.

To discover this vibrant city in your own time and at your own pace just download this self-guided audio tour, pop in your headphones, open the map that comes with your download and start walking.

The tour will take approximately 2 hours, but you can pause the audio guide when needed.

Please note this tour is only available in English.
